nativePlatform.tokenAuthority: ../DESIGN.md YAML frontmatter; exact explicit Kotlin values, no CSS conversion
nativePlatform.previewPolicy: Native-only adaptation of schemaVersion 2: components carry metadata, with Compose specifications in extensions.nativeComponents. HTML/CSS previews are deliberately omitted because no browser approximation is authoritative for Compose. No web preview or final device rendering is asserted.
nativePlatform.themeSelection: MainActivity maps saved dark/light/system to darkTheme. dynamicColor defaults to false and is not enabled at the call site. Optional LightColorScheme remains in source; it is not duplicated into the compact dark-world token set or renewed approval of rejected light proposals.
nativePlatform.materialDefaults: Unspecified color roles, component dimensions, ripple, focus, interaction layers and shapes remain library defaults; they were not reverse-engineered or replaced with guessed values.
nativePlatform.fontWeightResolution: 500 and 600 are requested TextStyle weights; no separate medium or semibold font resource is evidenced in Type.kt.

evidence.captureFreshness: First-pass captures are historical. The owner identifies review-phone-*.png as physical-device RC3 captures, not RC5. This refresh inventoried those filenames without inspecting rasters; neither set establishes current-source rendering.
evidence.reportedVerification: NEON-VERIFICATION.md is a historical compilation/test record, not current acceptance. RC5 compilation was reported in progress at the start of this refresh; its result was not checked. Component updates are source-backed only, not RC5 device or runtime acceptance.
evidence.blockedRecapture: Prior documentation records system_server/SystemUI ANRs under host memory pressure and an unresolved ProxyX resize/focus-timeout ANR. These remain historical unresolved findings, neither attributed to nor cleared by RC5; they are not a claim that current physical-device capture is blocked.
pending: Main user workflows on a usable device or emulator
evidence.documentationPass: Read named source/context and inventoried RC3 filenames; wrote only DESIGN.md and .impeccable/design.json. No raster inspection, builds, device/UI automation or preview pixel gates.

extensions.tonalRampPolicy: No synthetic eight-step ramps: Kotlin declares fixed role colors, not normative hue/chroma ramps. Invented OKLCH strips would not describe the native implementation. Role primitives live only in DESIGN.md.

headlineSmall.purpose: LTR numeric face when the gauge is compact and system fontScale > 1.15; source-defined reflow, not device-accepted legibility.

titleLarge.purpose: ProxyX app title, explicitly overridden to Bold at the shell call site.

titleSmall.purpose: Endpoint and settings titles; some call sites override to Bold.

bodyLarge.purpose: Settings option-dialog text. Fields retain unspecified native defaults; no field typography override is asserted.

bodyMedium.purpose: Endpoint row text with explicit LTR direction.

bodySmall.purpose: Secondary status, history and network evidence.

labelMedium.purpose: Navigation labels, stages, Home row metric values and small context.

labelSmall.purpose: Explicit MTProto/TCP captions on Home row and selected-endpoint metrics; not permission for ad hoc tiny type.

elevation.name: bottom-navigation-tonal
elevation.purpose: Explicit NavigationBar tonalElevation; not a global Material elevation override.

motion.name: benchmark-progress
motion.purpose: 180ms event-driven animateFloatAsState of runtime overallFraction, coerced to 0..1; LinearProgressIndicator reads animatedProgress.value in its progress callback. Overall text formats the runtime fraction, not animated state; no smoothness acceptance.

motion.name: favorite-scale
motion.purpose: Selection-triggered scale target 1.08f when favorite, otherwise 1f. Reduced-motion/device rendering not verified.

layout.breakpointSpace: Navigation threshold uses shell maxWidth; height thresholds use screen content maxHeight after Scaffold insets, not physical display pixels.
layout.direction: LocalLayoutDirection: Persian RTL, English LTR; endpointStyle copies TextDirection.Ltr
layout.compactGaugeLargeFont: useSideGaugeLabels(compact, fontScale) = compact && fontScale > 1.15f: 96dp numeric face, 16dp side-caption gap, caption widthIn(max = 180.dp). Other compact gauges remain 140dp; regular remains 176dp. Source-defined, not verified on RC5 hardware.
layout.touchTargetFloor: 48dp product requirement, not blanket verified coverage

button-benchmark.states: Run start or pause/resume; cancel overrides containerColor = colorScheme.error without an explicit content-color override. Disabled start overrides primary alpha to 0.3f.

button-test-home.shape: Material default, not an explicit 8dp override
button-test-home.states: No selected proxy disables it; testing changes command/icon to cancellation. Telegram opening is independent.

proxy-row.content: LTR endpoint, explicit evidence status and expandable native tools; no success inferred from selection
proxy-row.metric: Only nonhistorical reachable rows show the compact metric: MTProto with eligible currentProtocolLatency unless TCP-latency sorting is selected; otherwise TCP with proxy.latency. labelSmall caption, labelMedium LTR value. Never silently substitute TCP under MTProto.
proxy-row.selectedEndpointMetric: ActiveProxyHeroCard's noncollapsed layout shows MTProto plus eligible currentProtocolLatency using labelSmall/labelLarge. Its collapsed layout uses a Telegram button in that position.

field-count.compose: OutlinedTextField(..., keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = KeyboardType.Number), singleLine = true, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f))
field-count.states: Native focus/error/disabled presentation; digits normalized, bounded length; conflicting collection/testing disables input.
field-count.geometry: No custom field padding, stroke or focus glow extracted.

labeled-switches.semantics: Native Material Switch checked/enabled semantics plus localized Modifier.semantics contentDescription directly on the control.
labeled-switches.labels: Benchmark finalist transfer uses copy.telegramFinalistTransfer; private monitoring uses copy.monitorPrivate; private-node enable includes node.label; WEB transfer uses localized Real Telegram file transfer.
labeled-switches.verification: Source-backed names only, not TalkBack or full accessibility acceptance.

benchmark-progress.label: Localized Overall prefix; percentage wrapped in LTR isolation (U+2066/U+2069); formats runtime overallFraction, not per-stage pass rate or transfer speed.
benchmark-progress.formatter: Finite fractions clamp to 0..1; nonfinite becomes 0. Exact endpoints: 0% and 100%. Positive below 0.1%: <0.1%. Below 1%: one decimal with Locale.US. Remaining incomplete progress: integer percent capped at 99%.
benchmark-progress.indicator: LinearProgressIndicator(progress = { animatedProgress.value }): 8dp high, 4dp clipped corners, primary fill, primary alpha 0.20 track; tween(180).
benchmark-progress.verification: Draw callback and formatting are source-backed; no device smoothness or successful-completion claim.

chip-library-selected.layout: Horizontally scrollable category row, 16dp horizontal padding, 8dp gaps; native shape/default states

settings-row.icons: 24dp native Material icons; 16dp icon-to-text gap; arrow uses native auto-mirroring
settings-row.type: titleSmall with Bold override; bodySmall subtitle
settings-row.switchColors: checkedTrackColor = secondaryContainer; checkedThumbColor = secondary; checkedBorderColor = secondary
settings-row.container: SettingsCard: surface, 8dp corners, 1dp outlineVariant, 0dp elevation. Rows own their padding.

navigation-selected.roles: selectedIconColor and selectedTextColor = secondary; indicatorColor = secondaryContainer; bottom inactive roles = onSurfaceVariant
navigation-selected.behavior: Four destinations, bottom below rail threshold; saved page state; native semantics and interactions

telegram-action.brush: remember(primary, secondary, enabled): sweepGradient(primary, primary, secondary, primary); disabled uses outline only
telegram-action.drawing: radius = minDimension / 2 - 9dp; surface fill; 18dp ring at alpha 0.12; 6dp main ring; 1dp primary outer line at radius + 7dp and alpha 0.25
telegram-action.semantics: Role.Button, localized contentDescription, clickable only with selected endpoint; opens Telegram, not a VPN connection

latency-gauge.drawing: 12dp inset; 150-degree start, 240-degree sweep; 7dp StrokeCap.Round arc; 33 ticks at 7.5-degree steps, outline alpha 0.7. Tick outer radius = arc radius + 11dp when compact, arc radius - 10dp otherwise; major ticks extend inward 7dp, others 3dp. Missing latency arc alpha 0.35.
latency-gauge.largeFontReflow: compact && LocalDensity.current.fontScale > 1.15f: only the LTR headlineSmall numeral or missing dash remains inside a 96dp face; captions move beside it with a 16dp gap, 4dp vertical spacing and widthIn(max = 180.dp). At/below threshold, internal captions and headlineLarge numeral remain.
latency-gauge.valuePolicy: currentProtocolLatency requires nonblank matching network fingerprint, lastChecked > 0, isTelegramVerified and protocolLatency > 0. Benchmark filters in-run candidates by runtime start timestamp. Missing value is explicit, not zero/success.
latency-gauge.verification: RC5 source geometry and reflow only; RC3 phone captures do not prove collision-free or accessible RC5 rendering.

stage-strip.geometry: 32dp CircleShape markers, equal weighted columns, 4dp inter-column gaps, 6dp marker-to-label gap
stage-strip.states: COMPLETE primary/check; ACTIVE secondary/more; PAUSED secondary/pause; STOPPED error/close; PENDING and SKIPPED onSurfaceVariant/number. Every state has text.
stage-strip.truth: Three stages or four when transfersRequested; completed runs with zero stage attempts are SKIPPED, not complete; transfer requires its own result.

notCanonized: First-pass missing Home ring, endpoint direction, malformed sort segment geometry, stale-result ambiguity and wide light system-navigation strip; final source corrections lack rendered confirmation.
Ad hoc tiny detail text and FontFamily.Monospace metric overrides are not shared type tokens or accepted legibility.
UiUtils flag emoji usage in Home rows is an observed glyph-icon defect, not a house icon style.
Hard-coded local status colors (including Home readiness/source/private-node green and quarantine amber) are not a new global semantic palette.
Compact gauge caption overlap is not an accepted layout rule; outward ticks and RC5 large-font reflow remain source-only until current native verification.
No full touch-target, scaled-font, reduced-motion or workflow acceptance is claimed.

Earlier ProxyX resize/focus-timeout ANR, historical system ANRs, authenticated transfer and measured device smoothness remain outside accepted claims. RC5 compilation in progress and RC3 phone captures do not establish RC5 acceptance.

narrative.overview:
A near-black native Android utility with luminous cyan actions and violet selection, grounded in the owner's approved Persian four-screen concept. Vazirmatn, readable evidence and familiar Material 3 interactions carry the identity. The previous light design proposals were rejected; the implemented optional light theme is a user preference, not a competing approved concept.

The visual world supports choosing an endpoint, inspecting network-specific evidence, testing independently and opening Telegram. Light comes from bounded native drawing and tonal surfaces, not a web runtime or continuous effects. Keep the six-block surface contract and its quality bar in `docs/NEON-SURFACE-BRIEF.md`; the four-screen composition is not a universal screen template.
keyCharacteristics: Persian RTL and English LTR with explicitly LTR endpoint text.
Cyan action/evidence, violet selection and restrained amber uncertainty.
Outlined native surfaces, compact controls and bounded Canvas rings.
Scrollable work areas with adaptive native navigation.
Source-recorded design; final rendering and release acceptance remain pending.

rules.name: The Evidence Before Glow Rule
rules.body: Color accompanies explicit status text or icons; only fresh, current-network protocol evidence earns a measured latency. Unknown, historical and untested data never borrows a success treatment.

rules.name: The Unbroken Script Rule
rules.body: Keep Vazirmatn and zero letter spacing in shared typography; isolate endpoint direction without reversing Persian layout or introducing a decorative display face.

rules.name: The Bounded Light Rule
rules.body: Keep luminous emphasis local to native ring/gauge drawing and state; do not add continuous blur, 3D or a web animation runtime to reproduce the approved concept.

dos: Do use native Material color and typography roles from the recorded Kotlin theme, keeping dp and sp distinct.
Do retain Persian RTL, English LTR and explicit LTR endpoint text without adding letter spacing.
Do keep Telegram opening separate from testing and label historical, missing and other-network evidence explicitly.
Do preserve scrolling work areas, adaptive navigation and at least 48dp action targets while checking scaled-font layouts on a usable native device.
Do treat the approved concept as visual direction and first-pass/RC3 captures as historical evidence; require current native verification before RC5 acceptance.
donts: Don't restore the rejected light proposals as the approved identity or remove the retained optional light/system preference.
Don't translate native dp/sp or Material defaults into invented CSS pixels, web hover tokens or fabricated component previews.
Don't add continuous blur, 3D, background shaders or a web runtime for decorative neon effects.
Don't promote ad hoc tiny type, monospace metric overrides, emoji flag icons or inconsistent hard-coded status colors into shared design tokens.

Don't canonize first-pass ring absence, endpoint direction problems, segmented-corner defects, stale-result ambiguity or the wide light system strip; source corrections still require rendered confirmation.
Don't call this release-ready, resolve the resize ANR by assumption, or claim authenticated transfer, complete workflow coverage or measured device smoothness from compilation and tests.
